report.title: Transfer page does not reject negative amount
report.summary: The transfer page does not reject negative amounts as expected. This is a critical issue as it allows users to transfer invalid amounts.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Attempt to transfer a negative amount from one account to another.
report.expected: The transfer page should reject negative amounts and display an error message.
report.actual: The transfer page did not reject the negative amount and timed out waiting for the locator '#amt' to be visible.
evidence: Call log:  - waiting for locator("#amt") to be visible
report.suspected_cause: The transfer page's validation logic may be faulty.
report.next_action: The development team should review the transfer page's validation logic and ensure it correctly rejects negative amounts.
